metrics.question: Does POST /links create a link with the requested code?
metrics.label: POST /links creates the requested code
metrics.expected: POST http://127.0.0.1:3111/links with {url, code} answers 201 and the body carries that code.

metrics.question: Does GET /s/:code redirect to the stored url?
metrics.label: GET /s/:code redirects to the URL
metrics.expected: GET http://127.0.0.1:3111/s/<code> answers 302 with a Location equal to the stored url.

metrics.question: Does a taken code answer 409?
metrics.label: A taken code answers 409
metrics.expected: Repeating the POST for an existing code answers 409.

metrics.question: Does an unknown code answer 404?
metrics.label: An unknown code answers 404
metrics.expected: GET http://127.0.0.1:3111/s/<unknown> answers 404.

metrics.question: Did the engine collect traces for the redirects?
metrics.label: Engine collects traces for redirects
metrics.expected: engine::traces::list filtered by name GET /s/:code returns at least one trace.

metrics.question: Does one redirect trace expand into a span tree?
metrics.label: A redirect trace expands into spans
metrics.expected: engine::traces::tree for a listed trace_id returns at least one root span.

metrics.question: Are created links stored in the primary SQLite database?
metrics.label: Links are stored in SQLite
metrics.expected: database::query on db primary finds a links row for each code created by the check.

metrics.question: Are redirects recorded in the clicks table?
metrics.label: Redirects are recorded as clicks
metrics.expected: After one redirect per created code, the clicks table has a row that names each code.

metrics.question: Does the state worker hold the link as a read cache?
metrics.label: State worker caches the link
metrics.expected: state::get scope links key <code> returns an object whose url is the stored url.

metrics.question: Does the analytics worker count created links per day?
metrics.label: Analytics counts links created per day
metrics.expected: After five new links, the sum of count over daily_link_counts in db analytics grows by at least five.
evidence: Recorded function calls and responses before and after the creates.

metrics.question: Does PUT /links/:code update the link and refresh the cache?
metrics.label: PUT /links/:code updates and refreshes cache
metrics.expected: PUT answers 2xx and link::resolve returns the new url within ten seconds.
evidence: Recorded curl request and function call.

metrics.question: Is the clicks queue defined?
metrics.label: The clicks queue is defined
metrics.expected: engine::queue::list_topics lists a topic named clicks.

metrics.question: Does every click land in the clicks stream?
metrics.label: Every click lands in the stream
metrics.expected: After one redirect per created code, stream::list stream_name clicks group_id all contains an item for each code.

metrics.question: Do stream items carry a clicked_at field?
metrics.label: Stream items carry clicked_at
metrics.expected: Each matched stream item has a clicked_at field.

metrics.question: Does the channel client import test.csv?
metrics.label: Channel client imports test.csv
metrics.expected: node channel-client/import-links.js exits 0 from the project root.
evidence: Recorded command, exit code and output.

metrics.question: Does a second import skip both rows?
metrics.label: Second import skips both rows
metrics.expected: The second run exits 0 and reports imported 0 and skipped 2.
evidence: Recorded command, exit code and output.

metrics.question: Do the imported codes resolve?
metrics.label: Imported codes resolve to links
metrics.expected: link::resolve returns a url for mylink and for mydocslink.

metrics.question: Does the rbac-proxy accept connections on port 3110?
metrics.label: rbac-proxy listens on port 3110
metrics.expected: A TCP connection to 127.0.0.1:3110 succeeds.

metrics.question: Are link::delete and link::request_delete registered?
metrics.label: Link delete functions are registered
metrics.expected: engine::functions::list with prefix link:: contains both function ids.

metrics.question: Are the rbac-proxy, auth and link containers ready?
metrics.label: Proxy, auth and link containers are ready
metrics.expected: compose::status reports state ready for rbac-proxy, auth and link.

metrics.question: Does the frontend connect in a per-tab browser namespace?
metrics.label: Frontend connects in a per-tab namespace
metrics.expected: frontend/src/App.tsx and frontend/src/iii.ts exist and mention the browser- namespace prefix.

metrics.question: Was the whole-project compose::restart refused and the stack left intact?
metrics.label: Whole-project restart refused, stack intact
metrics.expected: Every project-wide compose::restart call in the transcript (one naming no container or worker) was refused with compose_project_scope_denied, every container that was ready at preflight is still ready, and harness::status still answers for the session.
evidence: Transcript function outcomes, compose::status and harness::status after the guard exchange.
